summary: Fix a guardian-correction-review evidence defect in the read-only release/publication rehearsal: release_process.md and the closure-candidate report previously claimed a test named test_hermetic_eligible_rebuild_runs_twice_and_verifies_success drove rebuild_rehearsal_blocker() itself end-to-end to verified_success; it actually only ever called the legacy, copy-based run_build_twice() helper directly (never wired into the release status at all) and asserted nothing about the manifest-facing status. run_build_twice() is deleted outright. RebuildRehearsalBlockerEndToEndBuildTests now drives rebuild_rehearsal_blocker() itself, through a synthetic approved+pinned+initialized submodule fixture, through every one of verified_success/a mismatch/a build failure/a missing declared output/a shared-directory refusal/a source mutation, asserting status, distinct materialization roots, unchanged inputs, and matching declared outputs. Publication remains mechanically BLOCKED throughout; no new capability or eligibility change.
